title: Glitter
novel: Barney [[stumbled|stumble]] upon a copy of a Canadian children's show called Space Teens. To his [[delight|delight]], the show starred Robin as her teenage [[alter-ego|alter-ego]], Robin Sparkles. Barney could not wait to share this discovery with the gang. He gathered everyone in the apartment and played the VHS tape. The show featured Robin and her best friend Jessica [[solving|solve]] mysteries in space while wearing [[sparkly|sparkly]] outfits. The gang was [[hysterical|hysterical]] with laughter. Robin tried to [[grab|grab]] the tape, but Barney held it out of her reach. She was [[mortified|mortify]] and begged them to turn it off. However, the more they watched, the more they noticed something [[unsettling|unsettle]] about the show. Robin and Jessica's friendship on screen seemed [[genuine|genuine]], but Robin revealed that they had a terrible [[falling-out|falling-out]] after the show ended. Jessica had [[blamed|blame]] Robin for ruining her career. Barney, feeling [[mischievous|mischievous]], tracked down Jessica and invited her to New York. Robin was [[furious|furious]] when she found out, but when Jessica arrived, the two women [[reconciled|reconcile]] almost immediately. They laughed about their old show and [[apologized|apologize]] to each other for years of [[silence|silence]]. Robin learned that holding onto [[grudges|grudge]] only hurt herself. The gang watched the two friends [[embrace|embrace]] and felt touched by the reunion. Barney, for once, had done something [[kind|kind]] without expecting anything in return. It was a rare [[glitter|glitter]] of warmth in his usually selfish world.
